incident-bot: :warning: High tail latency detected on /v1/chat.stream. p95 ~ 300ms -> p99 ~ 2.6s. Automating page to #incidents and on-call. root=1768625400

zoe (oncall): ack. seeing many streams with long pauses after the initial chunk. client-side logs show stalled chunks at 10-15s.

sam (eng-runtime): dashboards show preproc worker latencies spiking; avg tokenization time per request up 3-5x starting 03:07 UTC. request queue backlog increasing.

maya (eng-ml): flagged change: prompt-templater v2.14 rolled earlier today — added eager JSON-mode validation + full tool-schema expansion. suspect heavy recursive schema expansion for tool-within-tool cases.

lee (prod-sre): any HTTP 5xxs or timeouts?

tara (support): two enterprise customers reported stalled editor sessions and timed-out websocket at ~35s, filing SEV tickets 9110/9111. No mass errors, but UX broken for editors.

zoe (oncall): initial triage + mitigation plan (short): 1) disable eager JSON validation feature flag 2) enable preproc fast-path that skips schema expansion for streaming 3) add backpressure to router to slow new long-running streams 4) scale preproc pool x1.5.

sam (eng-runtime): executing step 1 now:
```
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://config-api.internal/v1/flags/templater_json_eager/disable
```
ops-bot: feature flag templater_json_eager disabled at 1768625465 by sam (eng-runtime)

maya (eng-ml): also toggled a temporary limiter to cap schema expansion depth to 3 to avoid pathological recursion. will revert when we ship proper fix.

sam (eng-runtime): enabling fast-path for streaming (non-blocking preproc): set ROUTER_STREAM_FASTPATH=true and bump preproc replicas:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/router ROUTER_STREAM_FASTPATH=true
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/preproc --replicas=9
```

ops-bot: router env change recorded at 1768625520. preproc scaled to 9 replicas.

incident-bot: metric update at 1768625580: p99 fell from 2.6s -> 1.2s; queue depth decreasing.

tara (support): customers 9110/9111 confirm partial recovery, editor streams resumed but report occasional brief hiccups. documented mitigation steps in tickets and notified PMs.

maya (eng-ml): root cause analysis draft: templater attempted to fully expand tool schemas inline for each request in JSON-mode. worst-case expansion across nested refs caused O(n^2) work and repeated traversal of shared sub-schemas. Two heavy customer templates hit the worst case.

sam (eng-runtime): observations: preproc CPU spikes correspond to requests with very large prompt-template expansions. streaming path was blocked waiting on preproc sync validation, causing tail stalls.

lee (prod-sre): medium-term fixes we need before closing: 1) implement memoization/caching of expanded schemas (per-model+template hash) 2) make schema expansion async and non-blocking for streaming responses (accept then validate) 3) add a max-expansion-size circuit that returns a sanitized fallback template if exceeded 4) add alerts on per-request preproc time > 500ms to catch regressions earlier.

zoe (oncall): added follow-ups for eng-ml and eng-runtime. handoff notes for next oncall: keep templater_json_eager disabled until memoization + size guards shipped and validated; monitor p99 < 1s for 20m.

maya (eng-ml): planned changes: - implement expansion cache keyed by (template_id, tool_schema_hash) - iterative expansion algorithm to avoid recursion blowup - microbench and integrate unit tests for pathological schemas - deprecate synchronous deep validation for streaming clients

sam (eng-runtime): planned changes: - introduce non-blocking preprocess path exposing a streaming-accept response header - add telemetry events: schema_expansion_time_ms, expand_count, expand_depth - add router-level slow-start to limit new interactive sessions when preproc latency rises

ops-bot: created incident ticket INF-2026 and linked SEV tickets 9110/9111 at 1768625820.

lee (prod-sre): current metrics: p95 ~ 260ms, p99 ~ 950ms after mitigations. keeping pager suppressed for 30m. will draft post-incident note and assign owners.

zoe (oncall): customer impact summary for handoff:
- affected endpoint: /v1/chat.stream (streaming websocket/chunked)
- trigger: prompt-templater v2.14 enabling eager JSON validation + full tool-schema expansion
- impact: elevated tail latency causing prolonged stalls/timeouts for small set of interactive customers (2 confirmed enterprise incidents)
- immediate mitigations: disable eager validation, enable streaming fast-path, limit expansion depth, scale preproc replicas
- status: p99 reduced under 1s, customers reporting recovery, continuing monitoring

zoe (oncall): handing to lee for monitoring and P1->postmortem conversion. leaving TODOs for maya/sam to implement hard fixes.

lee (prod-sre): taking over. please add implementation PR links to INF-2026 when available. thanks team :pray:
